grade: Crianças pequenas (4 anos a 5 anos e 11 meses)
subject: Escuta, Fala, Pensamento e Imaginação
description_pt: Levantar hipóteses sobre gêneros textuais veiculados em portadores conhecidos, recorrendo a estratégias de observação gráfica e/ou de leitura.

components.description_pt: Identificar gêneros textuais baseando-se em características gráficas de portadores familiares
components.description_en: Identify text genres based on graphic features of familiar text carriers
components.cc_component_description: Identify distinguishing features of storybooks versus informational books

components.description_pt: Gerar hipóteses sobre gênero de texto usando estratégias de observação visual
components.description_en: Generate hypotheses about a text's genre using visual observation strategies
components.cc_component_description: Generate and convey initial thinking about how or why something works

components.description_pt: Usar estratégias de leitura para inferir tipo de texto em portador familiar
components.description_en: Use reading strategies to infer the type of text presented in a familiar carrier
components.cc_component_description: Apply appropriate reading strategies to comprehend texts of increasing complexity

cc_matches.description: Read and comprehend complex literary and informational texts independently and proficiently.
Explain major differences between books that tell stories and books that give information, drawing on a wide reading of a range of text types.

Multilingual learners will…
* __Generate and convey initial thinking__
* Follow and describe cycles __and sequences of steps or procedures and their causes and effects__
* Compare changing __variables, factors, and circumstances__
* Offer __alternatives to extend or deepen awareness of factors that contribute to particular outcomes__
* Act on feedback to revise understandings of how or why something is or works __in particular ways__
